abstract: An interface to build machine learning models for classification and regression
  problems. 'mikropml' implements the ML pipeline described by Topçuoğlu et al. (2020)
  <https://doi.org/10.1128/mBio.00434-20> with reasonable default options for data
  preprocessing, hyperparameter tuning, cross-validation, testing, model evaluation,
  and interpretation steps. See the website <https://www.schlosslab.org/mikropml/>
  for more information, documentation, and examples.
